name: Key to the City
summary: Wordeen seeks a way into Dalaran, now rebuilt on the Dark Lady’s doorstep.

sections.title: The Rebuilt City
sections.body:
In Tarren Mill, Magus Wordeen Voidglare wants to learn more about the Kirin Tor. Their city, Dalaran, fell to the demonic Burning Legion in a single stroke from the arch demon Archimonde. The surviving mages became dispossessed vagabonds. Now they have rebuilt Dalaran on the Dark Lady’s very doorstep.

Wordeen sends you to search their camps. He hopes you will find an ancient tome, a secret relic, or something else that can get the Horde into the city unnoticed. What you bring back is a grimy Dalaran sewer key.

sections.title: Wordeen's Answer
sections.body: Wordeen sees the sewer key and gives thanks that someone else will use it. There is work to do before it is safe to use.

faq.q: Who gives the request for Key to the City?
aliases: who gives key to the city
where do i start key to the city
faq.answer: Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill asks you to help.

faq.q: Why is the Horde interested in Dalaran?
faq.answer: The Kirin Tor have rebuilt Dalaran on the Dark Lady’s doorstep after Archimonde destroyed their city. Wordeen wants to learn more about them and find a way for the Horde to enter unnoticed.

faq.q: What item are you sent to find?
aliases: what do i get for wordeen
faq.answer: You are sent to search the Kirin Tor camps for a grimy Dalaran sewer key.
